description: Identifies overlapping balls and zones (i.e. balls whose centroids lie within zones and the corresonding zones) and create the coupling datastructures.

examples.description: Build the ball-zone coupling data structures

notes: The 6.0 manual documents this command too, but the 6.00 binaries have no coupling commands at all (live top-level command enumeration on the PFC3D 6.00 GUI).
3D only live: the 2D binaries have no ball-zone command (7.00 and 9.8).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (plus the PFC3D 6.00 GUI for the 6.0 verdict) (syntax grade): accepted on PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 with in-process zones present; rejected at the top level on both 2D consoles and on 6.00.
